title: Final Answer Clockwise
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that the length of the unwound string increases at the rate of Rω for the clockwise direction.

title: Final Answer Counterclockwise
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that the length of the unwound string increases at the rate of Rω for the counterclockwise direction.

title: Reasoning for Clockwise
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the mass moves tangentially at speed Rω when the glue breaks.

title: Reasoning for Counterclockwise
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the fictitious forces in the rotating frame and how they lead to the same unwinding rate.

title: Use of Forces
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the roles of centrifugal and Coriolis forces in their explanation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that the units of the final answer are consistent and correctly expressed.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid incorrectly stating that the unwinding rate differs between clockwise and counterclockwise directions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit the factor of R in their final answer for the unwinding rate.
